transcript: I can always tell when two people are soulmates versus when they're just like not really meant to be together. It's one thing that I look for and it has been consistent in every single happy, healthy, long-term relationship I've ever seen or like people who are happily married, they all have this. And it's that they literally look physically similar to each other. And it's not always super obvious. Sometimes you really have to look to find it, but there's always something similar about their faces. Like whether it's their eye shape, maybe it's their facial structure, lips. There's something that's like, whoa, Oh. These two people literally look like they're meant to be together down to that level. And they could even be completely different races. It doesn't matter. They will look similar if they are soulmates. And I've also noticed on the other end, when a couple is like not meant to be together or they're not like soulmates, something about the two of them together just looks off. And it's because they're so, they just look so different. Like the best way I can explain it is like, if all of us were aliens that all came from different planets, soulmates would be two aliens from the same planet. So they look kind of similar. But if they're not soulmates, they look like they both came from two completely different planets. Like two completely separate types of aliens. Does that make sense? Like you get what I mean? I don't know man. Call me crazy, but now that I pointed it out, you are gonna start to notice it all the time. So you're welcome.
